warrumbungle.result: No kept place is inside Warrumbungle's 45 km radius. Nearest are Pilliga Sandstone Caves (50.1 km, held for pin) and the Pilliga Hot Artesian Bore Baths (103.9 km), reached through the Pilliga from Narrabri, so both are standalone. np_exceptions.note: Every national park is a destination (COVERAGE.md Granularity). These parks are NOT proposed as their own destinations because each would hold one place or none; listed for the owner, who may promote any of them.

folded_into_a_destination.note: also inside the Inverell radius (about 34 km); reached from Glen Innes per Wikivoyage

span_overlap_notes: Armidale (45 km) and Oxley Wild Rivers (50 km): centres 38.7 km apart, radii overlap, but the spots are assigned by access: Wollomombi (37 km from Armidale, outside its 33.75 km radius) and Apsley belong to the park; NERAM is the only Armidale spot that also falls in Oxley's radius.
Cunnawarra National Park lies inside both New England NP's and Oxley Wild Rivers' radii; it goes to New England NP (Waterfall Way, reached from Armidale/Ebor side).
Glen Innes/Inverell/Tenterfield/Gibraltar radii touch on empty country; the only spot in two radii is Kings Plains (above).
Warrumbungle's span is checked in existing_destinations_checked.
mid_north_coast_overlap: Dorrigo National Park (mid-north-coast proposal) is 37 km east of Ebor Falls, outside its 30 km radius; Waterfall Way stops west of Dorrigo are placed here and none of them is claimed there. See nsw-overlaps.md.
